safety.notes: Action+object patterns. Canon words such as 电锯, 电话, 火车, 火锅, 绳子 and scenery mushrooms are allowed. hard = weapons, gore, insults and the imitable dangers a child could copy (grabbing wires — 电话线 and 电缆 too —, jumping from a height, swallowing a small thing or having it in the belly, a small thing into the mouth unless it is blown, catching with the mouth: M3 r2 findings #4 and the review's R2CHK-4); soft also has setting bees on someone (R2CHK-15); soft = other imitable danger and 「死」 for degree (repair). substitutions = 「死」 words with one fixed replacement, made in code (safety.word); 死死 is dropped (抱得死死的 → 抱得很紧), since r2's 死死 → 紧紧 put 紧紧 into 42 lines of the panel's books (M3 r3 lean #1: 紧紧/牢牢 are a Tier B group). The picture brief (every text of it the image prompt copies: focus, place, time, weather, shot, mood, each who.act and who.face — M3 r3 review R3-SAFE-2) gets the soft patterns and the hard ones except `spoken` (insults are only said: a bird 「停在屋顶闭嘴」 is a beak) — safety.art (M3 r2 review). 子弹 after a noun ending in 子 is a bounce (帽子弹飞, 盖子弹开), not a bullet; 被 is not on that list (被子弹打中 is the passive). Every pattern also reads the text with the marks a word can be drawn out or broken up with taken out between two 汉字 (笨——蛋, 闭～嘴, 笨 蛋 are 笨蛋, 闭嘴: textutil.fold, M3 r3 review R3-SAFE-1), so a word here needs no stretched variants.

adult.notes: Words of grown-ups' business and written style for a 4–10-year-old listener (M3 r2 #15, findings #11): `words` are repaired once (adult) in pages, fork questions, options and hints, idea chips and display strings, and drop a secret's twist or ending template; `substitutions` have one fixed replacement, made in code (adult.word); longer keys win, so a word that holds one gets its own (内壁上 → 墙上, 我们三人 → 我们仨, 在场的人们 → 大家: the review found 墙上上, 我们他们仨, 大家们). 扣工资 once is canon and stays. false_friends hold an adult word without being one (在场地上 is 在 + 场地).
